opening.text: I've been turning yellow, feeling tired, and lightheaded. I get short of breath when I exert myself, and my urine has been dark. My stools have been dark brown to black. All of this started about a month ago and has been getting worse. I take methimazole. My mother has autoimmune hemolytic anemia, and my grandmother on my mother's side has had anemia with no cause ever found.
